About the Scholarship

Toronto's PhD in Information recruits applicants for information-related research with suitable faculty supervision. The advertised intake is 2027/28. Its funding package is a programme policy reference and should be checked for the new intake, including what remains after tuition and fees.

Research Areas

  • Information studies
  • Research methods
  • Information-related research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryMinimum CAD 40,000 funding package (Fall 2025 policy reference)

Eligibility and Requirements

Applicants must satisfy the Faculty of Information’s admission requirements for the PhD in Information. Detailed requirements and the application process are published on the faculty’s Admission and Applications Requirements page.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusIntake advertised; deadline to confirm
Deadline / consideration round2027/28 programme deadline not verified
LocationCanada

About University of Toronto

Toronto's Faculty of Information offers doctoral research in information-related fields. Applicants identify relevant supervision and follow the faculty's PhD admission process, with financial support governed by its funding policy.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://ischool.utoronto.ca/phd-in-information/

Source: ischool.utoronto.ca - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 2027/28 programme deadline not verified - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 2027/28 programme deadline not verified. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
